describe:
Idea Pipeline, in the teal colours.
Keeps:
- idea: title: text; stage: one of Spark, Trying, Shipped, starts at Spark. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: tab, starting at All.
Shows:
- a bar with "Idea Pipeline" and a button that opens a form to add a idea.
- how many idea entries where stage is Shipped out of how many idea entries with a progress bar, labelled "ideas shipped".
- for each choice of the stage of the idea:
  - a button the choice, how many idea entries where stage is the choice; a tap sets tab to the choice.
- a button "All"; a tap sets tab to All.
- for each idea where tab is All or stage is tab sorted by at, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the idea for editing; a swipe removes the idea, with undo:
    - text: the title of the idea.
    - text: the stage of the idea.
    - if the stage of the idea is Spark:
      - a button "Try it"; a tap sets the stage of the idea to Trying.
    - if the stage of the idea is Trying:
      - a button "Shipped"; a tap sets the stage of the idea to Shipped.
needs: one tap to move an idea on

describe:
Milestones, in the purple colours.
You can change: "Date of birth": date, starts at 1995-06-01.
Shows:
- a box to fill in born.
- a card with a big number today minus born, labelled "days old today", with a ring toward 20000 when there is one.
- a card titled "Milestone dates" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: days ago or days to go

describe:
Decisions, in the yellow colours.
Keeps:
- decision: what: text; owner: text; revisit: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Decision log" and a button that opens a form to add a decision.
- a card with a big number how many decision entries where revisit is at most today, labelled "decisions to revisit of" countdecision, with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each decision sorted by at, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the decision for editing; a swipe removes the decision, with undo:
    - text: the what of the decision.
    - text: the owner of the decision, "· revisit", the revisit of the decision.
    - if the revisit of the decision is at most today:
      - text: "Due".
Reminder "Time to revisit a decision" on each revisit of the decision entries.
needs: add a decision with owner and revisit date

describe:
Taxi Fleet, in the yellow colours.
Keeps:
- car: plate: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- log: car: a car; kind: one of Income, Fuel, Repair, Challan, starts at Income; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- income is the total amount of log this month where kind is Income.
- profit is income minus the result of the total amount of log this month minus income.
Shows:
- a bar with "Taxi Fleet" and a button that opens a form to add a car.
- a card with a big number profit, labelled "fleet profit this month," income "income", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each car sorted by plate:
  - a group; a tap opens the car for editing:
    - text: the plate of the car.
    - text: "income", inc.
    - text: net.
- a card titled "Log an entry" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of log, first 8; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: add a car with its plate
log income, fuel or repair with an amount for a car
profit this month for each car

describe:
Macro Pie, in the blue colours.
Keeps:
- meal: what: text; protein: number, 0 to 200; carbs: number, 0 to 400; fat: number, 0 to 200. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- p is the total protein of meal today times 4.
- c is the total carbs of meal today times 4.
- f is the total fat of meal today times 9.
- tot is the larger of p plus c plus f and 1.
- a1 is 360 times p divided by tot.
- a2 is a1 plus 360 times c divided by tot.
Shows:
- a bar with "Macro Pie" and a button that opens a form to add a meal.
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels.
- text: "Protein", the total protein of meal today, "g".
- text: "Carbs", the total carbs of meal today, "g".
- text: "Fat", the total fat of meal today, "g".
- text: "kcal today".
- a list of meal today; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: log a meal with protein, carbs and fat grams
pie chart of today's macro split

describe:
Solo standup, in the yellow colours.
Keeps:
- did: project: text; what: long text; hours: number, 0 to 16, in h. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Daily hours target": number, starts at 6.
Shows:
- a bar with "Solo standup" and a button that opens a form to add a did.
- a card with a big number the total hours of did this week, labelled "hours this week", with a ring toward target times 5 when there is one.
- a card with a big number the current day streak of did entries, labelled "day streak", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Days I worked" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Hours per day" with "target" target "h" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of did by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: add an update with project, what I did and hours
hours per day chart with a 6 hour target
dots for days with work this week

describe:
Roll Call, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- arrival: pupil: text; came: time of day. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a card with a big number how many arrival entries this week where came is more than 8:30, labelled "late arrivals this week", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- for each arrival today sorted by came, highest first:
  - a group; a tap opens the arrival for editing; a swipe removes the arrival, with undo:
    - text: the pupil of the arrival.
    - text: the came of the arrival.
    - if the came of the arrival is more than 8:30:
      - text: "Late", the result of the result of the came of the arrival minus 8:30 divided by 1 minute, "min".
    - otherwise:
      - text: "On time".

PR cycle, in the orange colours, always in dark mode.
Keeps:
- pr: title: text; opened: date, starts at today; "Days to merge": number, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "PR cycle time" and a button that opens a form to add a pr.
- a card with a big number the average cycle of pr times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "days average to merge," countpr where cycle = 0 "open", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Last PRs" with "days to merge" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- for each pr where cycle is 0 sorted by opened:
  - a group; a tap opens the pr for editing; a swipe removes the pr, with undo:
    - text: the title of the pr.
    - text: "open for", today minus the opened of the pr, "days".
    - a button "Merged"; a tap sets the cycle of the pr to the larger of today minus the opened of the pr and 0.
needs: add a PR with opened date

describe:
Loan, in the red colours.
Keeps:
- instalment: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Loan amount": money, starts at 240000; "Monthly instalment": money, starts at 20000.
Works out:
- paid is the total amount of instalment.
- left is the larger of 0 and loan minus paid.
Shows:
- a bar with "Loan" and a button that opens a form to add a instalment.
- paid out of loan with a progress bar, labelled "repaid so far".
- a card with a big number left, labelled "still to pay", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card with a big number the result of left plus monthly minus 1 divided by monthly rounded down, labelled "instalments to go", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a list of instalment by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

PR Board, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- pr: lift: one of Squat, Bench, Deadlift, Press, Pull up, starts at Squat; kg: number, 0 to 400; reps: number, 1 to 30, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: l, starting at Squat.
Shows:
- a bar with "PR Board" and a button that opens a form to add a pr.
- for each choice of the lift of the pr:
  - a button the choice; a tap sets l to the choice.
- a card with a big number the highest of est of its kg and its reps over the pr where lift is l rounded, labelled "best estimated one-rep max for" l "kg", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a card titled "Progress" with l on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a list of pr where lift is l; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
needs: log a lift with weight and reps
line chart of the estimate over time

describe:
Tubewell time, in the yellow colours.
Works out:
- hours is acres times depth times 3630 divided by the larger of cusec times 3600 and 0.1.
Remembers while you use it: acres, starting at 3; depth, starting at 3; cusec, starting at 1; hour cost, starting at 450.
Shows:
- a card titled "Field" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card titled "Tube well" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number hours times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "hours of running", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- a big number: hours rounded down, labelled "hours and" roundhours % 1 * 60 "min".
- a big number: hours times hour cost rounded, labelled "irrigation cost".
- text: "One acre-inch of water is 3630 cubic feet. One cusec is one cubic foot a second.".

Rate Board, in the green colours.
You can change: "Local money per 1 USD": number, at least 0, starts at 280; "Local money per 1 EUR": number, at least 0, starts at 305; "Local money per 1 GBP": number, at least 0, starts at 355.
Remembers while you use it: price, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in price, labelled "Price in local money".
- if price is more than 0:
  - a card titled "Ask the customer for" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type a price to see it in dollars, euros and pounds.".
- a card titled "Today's rates" with "tap to change" on the right, holding the lines under it.
needs: type the price in local money
amount in dollar, euro and pound

Meal Plan, in the orange colours.

see the whole week on one tab
counts of meals planned and items to buy

describe:
Plot Price, in the pink colours.

- marlas is count times 20 when size is Kanal, otherwise 1.

- total is marlas times rate.

- a box to fill in count, labelled "Size".
- a box to fill in rate, labelled "Price per marla".

  - a big number: total divided by feet rounded, labelled "per square foot".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type the price per marla to see the total.".

describe:
Ushr, in the orange colours.
Keeps:
- gave: maunds: number, at least 0; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- pct is 10 when water is Rain, otherwise 5.
- due is maunds times pct divided by 100.
Remembers while you use it: maunds, starting at 120; rate, starting at 4000; water, starting at Tubewell.
Shows:
- a card titled "Harvest" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
- a card with a big number due times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "maunds due, which is" pct "%", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- text: "In money", due times rate rounded.
- the total maunds of gave out of due with a progress bar, labelled "given so far".
- a button "Give 1 maund"; a tap adds a gave with maunds set to 1.
- a button "Give 5 maunds"; a tap adds a gave with maunds set to 5.
- a list of gave, first 5; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

Runtime EOL, in the orange colours.

- svc: name: text; runtime: text; eol: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a bar with "Runtime EOL" and a button that opens a form to add a svc.
- a card with a big number how many svc entries where eol is less than today, labelled "past end of life," countsvc where eol >= today and eol - today < 90 "within 90 days", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.

needs: add a service with runtime and EOL date

describe:
Pace Convert, in the pink colours.
Works out:
- secs is m times 60 plus s.
Remembers while you use it: m, starting at 5; s, starting at 30.
Shows:
- a box to fill in m, labelled "Minutes per km".
- a box to fill in s, labelled "Seconds".
- if secs is 0:
  - text: "Enter a pace to convert.".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Per mile".
  - text: secs times 1.609344 times 1 seconds.
  - text: "Speed", 3600 divided by secs times 10 rounded divided by 10, "km/h".
  - text: "5 km in", secs times 5 times 1 seconds.

Buy Get Free, in the orange colours.
Works out:
- size is buy plus free.
- paid is want divided by size rounded down times buy plus the smaller of want leaves over when divided by size and buy.
- total is paid times price.
Remembers while you use it: price, starting at 0; buy, starting at 2; free, starting at 1; want, starting at 6.
Shows:
- a box to fill in price, labelled "Price per item".
- text: "Buy", buy.
- a slider for buy from 1 to 10.
- text: "Get free", free.
- a slider for free from 0 to 5.
- a box to fill in want, labelled "Items wanted".
- if price is more than 0 and want is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number total, labelled "to pay for" pluralwant, "item", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a big number: total divided by want times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "real price per item".
  - a big number: the result of 1 minus paid divided by want times 100 rounded, labelled "percent saved".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type the price and how many you want.".
needs: real price per item and percent saved

describe:
Mess Bill, in the teal colours.
Keeps:
- member: name: text; days: number, 0 to 31, starts at 30. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- units is the total days of member plus guests divided by 3.
- perday is bill divided by units when units is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Remembers while you use it: bill, starting at 0; guests, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a bar with "Mess" and a button that opens a form to add a member.
- a box to fill in bill, labelled "Mess bill this month".
- text: "Guest meals", guests.
- a slider for guests from 0 to 60.
- if bill is more than 0 and units is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number perday times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "per day", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - for each member:
    - text: the name of the member.
    - text: the days of the member, "days".
    - text: perday times the days of the member rounded.
  - text: "Guests pay", perday times guests divided by 3 rounded.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Add members and type the bill to see the shares.".
needs: guest meals counted as extra days

describe:
Swim Pace, in the ocean colours.
Works out:
- metres is laps times 25 when pool is M25, otherwise 50.
- secs total is mins times 60 plus secs.
- pace is secs total divided by metres times 100 when metres is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Remembers while you use it: laps, starting at 40; pool, starting at M25; mins, starting at 30; secs, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in laps, labelled "Laps (one length each)".
- a choice of pool.
- a box to fill in mins, labelled "Minutes".
- a box to fill in secs, labelled "Seconds".
- text: "Distance", metres, "m".
- text: "Pace per 100 m", pace divided by 60 rounded down, ":", "0" when pace leaves over when divided by 60 rounded is less than 10, otherwise "", pace leaves over when divided by 60 rounded.

Courier Rate, in the orange colours.
Works out:
- first is 150 when zone is Same city, otherwise 250 when zone is Other city, otherwise 400.
- extra is 60 when zone is Same city, otherwise 90 when zone is Other city, otherwise 150.
- ceilkg is 0 minus 0 minus kg rounded down.
- base is first plus the larger of ceilkg minus 1 and 0 times extra.
Remembers while you use it: kg, starting at 2; zone, starting at Same city; cod, starting at no.
Shows:
- text: "Weight", kg, "kg".
- a slider for kg from 1 to 30.
- a choice of zone.
- text: "Cash on delivery (+2%)".
- a tick box for cod.
- a card with a big number base times 1.02 when cod, otherwise 1 rounded, labelled "delivery charge", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
- text: "First kg", first, "+", the larger of ceilkg minus 1 and 0, "extra kg at", extra.
needs: pick same city, other city or remote
charge by zone with extra kg

describe:
Margin Check, in the red colours.
Works out:
- profit is sell minus cost.
- margin is profit times 100 divided by sell when sell is more than 0, otherwise 0.
- markup is profit times 100 divided by cost when cost is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Remembers while you use it: cost, starting at 0; sell, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in cost, labelled "Cost price".
- a box to fill in sell, labelled "Selling price".
- if cost is more than 0 and sell is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number profit, labelled "loss on each piece" when profit is less than 0, otherwise "profit on each piece", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a big number: margin times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "percent margin".
  - a big number: markup times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "percent markup".
  - if profit is less than 0:
    - text: "You are selling below cost.".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Enter both prices and I will tell you your margin.".
needs: type cost price and selling price
shows profit or loss per piece

sold 1 kg and add 5 kg buttons

Calories, in the mint colours.
Works out:
- bmr is 10 times kg plus 6.25 times cm minus 5 times age plus 5 when sex is Male, otherwise minus 161.
- factor is 1.2 when act is Desk job, otherwise 1.375 when act is Light, otherwise 1.55 when act is Moderate, otherwise 1.725.
- burn is bmr times factor rounded.
- target is burn plus minus 500 when aim is Lose, otherwise 300 when aim is Gain, otherwise 0.
- protein is kg times 1.8 rounded.
- fat is target times 0.25 divided by 9 rounded.
- carbs is the larger of the result of target minus protein times 4 minus fat times 9 divided by 4 rounded and 0.
Remembers while you use it: sex, starting at Male; kg, starting at 70; cm, starting at 170; age, starting at 30; act, starting at Light; aim, starting at Keep.

- a card with a big number target, labelled "kcal a day to" aim, with a ring toward burn when there is one.
